description: This file defines a benchmark class for testing Trie-based policy algorithms in the Ditto framework. It extends an abstract benchmark class and provides a concrete implementation of the 'getPolicyAlgorithm' method that instantiates a 'TrieBasedPolicyAlgorithm' with a given policy.

classes.name: TrieBasedPolicyAlgorithmBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmark class for testing Trie-based policy algorithms, extending AbstractPoliciesBenchmark and implementing the method to instantiate TrieBasedPolicyAlgorithm.

methods.name: getPolicyAlgorithm
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of TrieBasedPolicyAlgorithm initialized with the provided Policy object.
